augments.name: Back To Basics
augments.wikiDescription: Your champion abilities deal 35% increased damage and you gain 70 ability haste and 35% increased healing and shielding from all sources, but your ultimate ability is permanently sealed .

augments.name: Biggest Snowball Ever
augments.wikiDescription: Upgrades your Mark into a massive snowball, empowering it with an increased size radius and the ability to pass through non-champions. The snowball additionally explodes upon impact of the target hit to deal 200 – 350 (based on level) (+ 100% bonus AD) (+ 60% AP) magic damage to all nearby enemies, knock them up for 0. 75 seconds, and slow them by 20% for 2 seconds. Additionally, your Mark's cooldown is reduced equivalent to 100 ability haste. If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark . Non-champions hit by the snowball are stunned for 1. 25 seconds.

augments.name: Blade Waltz
augments.wikiDescription: Replace a summoner spell with Blade Waltz . Blade Waltz: Blink to the target enemy champion. After 0. 25 seconds, you then blink to the nearest other enemy champion every 0. 25 seconds over the next 1. 25 seconds, blinking up to 5 additional times. Each time you blink to a target, deal 30 – 150 (based on level) (+ 10% bonus AD) (+ 6% AP) physical damage to them and apply on-hit effects at 50% effectiveness, up to a total of 180 – 900 (based on level) (+ 60% bonus AD) (+ 36% AP) . While Blade Waltz is active, you are untargetable and unable to act . This effect will end prematurely if there are no longer any nearby valid targets to blink to. A target can be blinked to more than once if there are no other valid targets in range.

augments.name: Bounce of the Poro King
augments.name_ja: ポロキングのバウンド
augments.wikiDescription: Replace a summoner spell with Bounce of the Poro King . Bounce of the Poro King: Transform into the Poro King for 3 seconds, during which you gain 70% damage reduction, 40% bonus movement speed , crowd control immunity , and ghosting , but become unable to declare basic attacks and cast abilities. Upon transformation, you also cleanse yourself of all crowd control . While transformed, you bounce up and down every 1 second, with each bounce dealing 100 – 700 (based on level) physical damage to nearby enemy champions and knocking them back upon landing. An enemy champion can be hit by multiple bounces, but ones beyond the first do not apply the knock back.

augments.name: Cerberus
augments.wikiDescription: Gain the Hail of Blades and Press the Attack keystone runes. Hail of Blades Bonus attack speed for melee champions increased to 200% from 140%. Bonus attack speed for ranged champions increased to 115% from 100% (ARAM override value). Press the Attack Bonus damage increased to 120 – 360 (based on level) from 40 – 160 (based on level) . Damage amplifier increased to 15% from 8%. New Effect: Bonus damage now scales with 40% AD and 30% AP .

augments.name: Circle of Death
augments.wikiDescription: Healing and health regeneration you do causes you to deal 70% of that value in magic damage to the nearest enemy champion within 1000 units.

augments.name: Clown College
augments.wikiDescription: Gain Shaco's Backstab , Deceive and Hallucinate's explosion. Replace a summoner spell with Deceive . Passive - Backstab: Your basic attacks deal 20 – 35 (based on level) (+ 50% bonus AD) (+ 35% AP) bonus physical damage on-hit when hitting an enemy from behind. Active - Deceive: Become invisible for up to 3 seconds and blink to the target location within 400 units after a 0. 125 -second delay. Your next basic attack while in stealth deals 100 (+ 150% bonus AD) (+ 55% AP) bonus physical damage , increased to 「 155 (+ 232. 5 % bonus AD) (+ 85. 25 % AP) bonus physical damage 」 「 155% damage 」 if Backstab was applied (45 second cooldown). Passive - Hallucinate Death: Upon your death, release an explosion in a 350 radius of your death location, dealing 25% of target's maximum health true damage to enemies within. Additionally, you deploy a box at the location of your death that instantly fears nearby enemies for 1 second. This box does not attack but lasts for 3 seconds.

augments.name: Courage of the Colossus
augments.wikiDescription: Immobilizing or grounding an enemy champion grants a shield for 3 seconds that absorbs 150 – 450 (based on level) (+ 4% maximum health) damage (5 second cooldown per cast instance ). Shields can stack between multiple triggers of this effect, though not refreshing the duration of previous shields.

augments.name: Cruelty
augments.wikiDescription: Immobilizing or grounding an enemy champion summons a comet above them that lands at their current location after 1 second, dealing 50 – 150 (based on level) (+ 40% AP) (+ 4% of your maximum health) magic damage to enemies within the area (6 second cooldown per target per cast instance ).

augments.name: Dashing
augments.wikiDescription: Abilities with dashes or blinks gain 175 ability haste . On Kalista , this augment instead grants her 125% bonus attack speed . [1]

augments.name: Devil on Your Shoulder
augments.wikiDescription: Forge a pact with Little Devil Teemo , who drains 0. 5 % of your current health every second, increased to 5% if there are enemy champions within 1000 units. In return, you deal 20% bonus true damage and your basic attacks and abilities summon a Life Remnant nearby for 5 seconds (0. 75 -second spawn cooldown). You can absorb a Life Remnant by moving over it, healing you for 50 – 150 (based on level) (+ 50% bonus AD) (+ 25% AP) and granting you 15% bonus movement speed .

augments.name: Draw Your Sword
augments.wikiDescription: Become melee , modifying your attack range to 200 (+ 100% bonus attack range from augments) units. Additionally, gain 30% bonus attack damage , 25% bonus attack speed , 30% bonus health , 25% bonus movement speed , and 20% life steal. These bonuses are increased by 0% – 30% (based on champion's default attack range) . This augment is only available for ranged champions. This augment is not offered if the champion has built Runaan's Hurricane .

augments.name: Dropkick
augments.wikiDescription: Your basic attacks and abilities execute enemy champions below 5% (+ 3. 5 % per 100 base AD) (+ 2% per 1000 bonus health) of their maximum health , which causes their corpse to be sent flying away in a line. Upon collision with an enemy champion or terrain, the target's corpse explodes to deal 150 – 500 (based on level) (+ 100% bonus armor) (+ 100% bonus magic resistance) magic damage to nearby enemies. Successful executions heal you for 100 – 300 (based on level) (+ 25% bonus health) . The execution may also be triggered by the explosion and goes through shields .

augments.name: Droppybara
augments.wikiDescription: Replace a summoner spell with Droppybara . Droppybara: Call upon a massive capybara to land down at the target location after 2. 5 seconds, dealing true damage equal to the 30% of the target's maximum health to enemies within a 650 radius. Deals 70% damage to minions. This augment is only offered to up to 1 player on each team for a given game.

augments.name: Dual Wield
augments.wikiDescription: Your basic attacks launch a bolt at the target that fires after a 0. 225 -second delay on-attack , deals 40% of the triggering attack's pre-mitigation damage, and applies on-hit effects at 40% effectiveness. Additionally, increase your total attack speed by 10% .

augments.name: Empowered By The Faithful
augments.wikiDescription: Granting a heal or shield to an allied champion blesses them for 8 seconds. Whenever a blessed ally damages an enemy champion, you generate a stack of Devotion , stacking up to 50 times. Upon reaching maximum stacks, you unleash a shockwave that deals 50 – 300 (based on level) (+ 750% heal and shield power) magic damage to nearby enemies. Enemy champions damaged below a percentage of their maximum health equal to 25% of your heal and shield power are executed .

augments.name: Empyrean Promise
augments.wikiDescription: Replace a summoner spell with Empyrean Promise's Vigilance active. Additionally, gain 15% heal and shield power . Active - Vigilance: After a 0. 25 -second delay, dash to the current location of the target allied champion and gain a 100 – 250 (based on level) (+ 100% AP) (+ 10% bonus health) shield for 3 seconds. Upon arrival, grant the ally the same shield (20 second cooldown; 2000 range).

augments.name: Eureka
augments.wikiDescription: Gain ability haste equal to 30% AP .

augments.name: Fan The Hammer
augments.wikiDescription: Your next basic attack against an enemy champion in each cardinal direction within 750 range additionally on-attack fires 5 Firecrackers at the target that each deal 8 – 51 (based on level) (+ 14% bonus AD) physical damage , for a total of 40 – 255 (based on level) (+ 70% bonus AD) physical damage (5 second cooldown per direction). Firecrackers' damage is increased by 0% – 50% (based on distance travelled) . Each Firecracker can critically strike for (200% + 30% ) damage and applies on-hit effects at 20% effectiveness.

augments.name: Feel the Burn
augments.wikiDescription: Replace a summoner spell with Feel the Burn . Feel the Burn: Casts both Exhaust and Ignite on all enemy champions within 800 units, with the former having its slow strength increased to 50% and the latter modified to deal 70 – 410 (based on level) true damage over the duration. This effect counts as a Burn source.

augments.name: Fey Magic
augments.wikiDescription: Damaging enemies with your ultimate ability polymorphs them into harmless critters for 2 seconds, during which their base movement speed is reduced by 60 , and disarms them for the same duration (15 second cooldown per target).

augments.name: Final Form
augments.wikiDescription: Casting your ultimate ability empowers you for 10 seconds, causing you to gain a shield for 50% of your maximum health , 20% omnivamp , and 30% bonus movement speed for the duration (20 second cooldown).

augments.name: Gash
augments.wikiDescription: Basic attacks on-hit deal ( 20 – 40 / 10 – 20 ) (based on level) (+ ( 25% / 20% ) bonus armor) bonus true damage . Additionally, gain 50% bonus attack speed .

augments.name: Giant Slayer
augments.name_ja: ジャイアント スレイヤー
augments.wikiDescription: Become tiny, reducing your size by 75% and granting you 20% bonus movement speed . Additionally, deal 10% / 15% / 25% / 30% (based on target's size) bonus damage against enemy champions with greater size than you.

augments.name: Glass Cannon
augments.wikiDescription: You gain a health threshold equal to 70% maximum health which cannot be modified nor exceeded by any means. In return, you deal bonus true damage equal to 15% of all of the damage you deal pre-mitigation .

augments.name: Goldrend
augments.wikiDescription: Damaging basic attacks or abilities against enemy champions deal 50 – 150 (based on level) (+ 40% bonus AD) (+ 20% AP) bonus magic damage , and grant you 30 and 25% bonus movement speed for 1. 5 seconds (30 second cooldown per champion).

augments.name: Goliath
augments.wikiDescription: Grants 35% bonus health , 15% adaptive force , and 50% increased size.

augments.name: Hand of Baron
augments.wikiDescription: Gain a modified Hand of Baron , which only grants 25% increased adaptive force and greatly empowers nearby allied minions .

augments.name: Heads Up Cupcake!
augments.name_ja: カップケーキに要注意！
augments.wikiDescription: Periodically, Cupcakes will fly across the map. Champions can consume a Cupcake by moving within 300 units of it, healing them and their nearby allied champions for 50 – 250 (based on level) (+ 5% – 15% (based on level) missing health) , as well as slowing all targets by 25% for 0. 5 seconds. Cupcakes also grant 50 to the champion who consumed it. Additionally, for every 1000 healing done by Cupcakes , you gain 150 . Healing granted by Cupcakes counts as self-healing .

augments.name: Holy Snowball
augments.wikiDescription: After using the Dash spell from Mark , you become invulnerable for 1. 5 seconds upon arrival. Additionally, your Mark's cooldown is reduced equivalent to 100 ability haste. If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark .

augments.name: I'm a Baby Kitty Where is Mama
augments.name_zh_TW: 我是小貓咪媽咪在哪裡
augments.name_ja: ボクは子ネコ。ママはどこ？
augments.wikiDescription: Bind with the nearest allied champion to you after 2 seconds, forming a tether between you and them (400 radius). While the tether persists, you gain 75% bonus movement speed and 50% heal and shield power . Additionally, gain 37. 5 % bonus movement speed while facing your bound ally within 1500 units. The tether will break when you or your bound ally dies, allowing you to form a new tether.

augments.name: Infernal Conduit
augments.wikiDescription: Your ability hits against champions apply a Burn for 3 seconds that deals 「 2 – 20 (based on level) (+ 4. 6 % bonus AD) (+ 2% AP) bonus magic damage per second 」 「 6 – 60 (based on level) (+ 14% bonus AD) (+ 6% AP) bonus magic damage over the duration 」 (1 second cooldown per cast instance ). This Burn stacks infinitely and refreshes with each application. Additionally, all of your Burn effects reduce the cooldowns of all your basic abilities by 0. 08 seconds for each tick of damage they deal to a target. Damage over time effects from all sources except items (unexpected) count as Burn sources for triggering the cooldown reduction. Eligible Augments for Burn : Buff Buddies, Feel the Burn, Firebrand, Grandma's Chili Oil, Holy Fire, Infernal Conduit, Slow Cooker, Tormentor

augments.name: Infinite Recursion
augments.wikiDescription: Gain 60 ability haste , increased by 3 each time you score a champion takedown .

augments.name: Jeweled Gauntlet
augments.name_ja: ジュエル ガントレット
augments.wikiDescription: Your abilities can now critically strike for (145% + bonus critical damage ) damage. Additionally, gain 25% (+ 4. 5 % per 100 AP) critical strike chance . If both Jeweled Gauntlet and Vulnerability are equipped, only rolls the critical strike chance of the augment that has the higher critical damage (or either if equal). The interaction between Jeweled Gauntlet and Vulnerability may behave incorrectly with persistent area damage effects. (bug)

augments.name: King Me
augments.wikiDescription: Upon entering the enemy team's gate or Catapult for the first time, either of which are located near their spawn , you become Kinged , causing you to gain one random Prismatic-tier augment and the first eligible Legendary item in your inventory to be upgraded with improved stats. The gold value of all upgradeable stats on the item is increased by exactly 1000 . King Me prioritize upgrading the first Legendary item eligible for a upgrade based on its position in the inventory, detecting each slot until an eligible item is found.

augments.name: Laser Heal
augments.wikiDescription: Replace a summoner spell with Laser Heal . Laser Heal: Channel for up to 2. 5 seconds to project an energy beam in the target direction, during which you can steer the beam in the direction of the cursor. The beam heals you and allies within for 200 – 550 (based on level) (+ 70% AP) (+ 50% bonus health) and deals 100 – 350 (based on level) (+ 50% AP) magic damage to enemies within, both over the duration. Enemies hit are also slowed by 20%. Laser Heal can be recast during the channel to end it early. Healing granted by the laser counts as self-healing .

augments.name: Mad Scientist
augments.wikiDescription: Upon acquiring this augment and each time you respawn, gain either 30% adaptive force , 20% bonus health , and 40% increased size or 70 ability haste , 40% bonus movement speed , and 40% reduced size.

augments.name: Master of Duality
augments.wikiDescription: Basic attacks on-hit grant 6 – 18 (based on level) ability power and damaging abilities once per cast instance grant 3 – 9 (based on level) bonus attack damage , lasting for 5 seconds, with the duration of both refreshing on subsequent hits, and stacking infinitely.

augments.name: Mystic Punch
augments.wikiDescription: Basic attacks on-hit reduce the remaining cooldowns of your abilities by 1. 25 seconds.

augments.name: Ominous Pact
augments.wikiDescription: Your abilities now have a health cost of 5% current health to cast them. In return, you gain ability power based on your missing health , up to 75 – 150 (based on level) at 70% missing health , 0% – 50% (based on missing health) bonus movement speed , and 0% – 20% (based on missing health) omnivamp .

augments.name: Omni Soul
augments.wikiDescription: Grants 3 random Dragon Souls .

augments.name: Prom Queen
augments.wikiDescription: Automatically cast a modified version of Rakan's The Quickness , empowering you to break into a captivating sprint for 6 seconds. While empowered, you gain ghosting and 50% bonus movement speed , and enemies you collide with are knocked down and become charmed for 1. 5 seconds (35 second cooldown). A sparkly tiara will descend upon you 2. 5 seconds before the effect activates.

augments.name: Protein Shake
augments.wikiDescription: Gain 25% (+ 35% per 100 bonus armor) (+ 35% per 100 bonus magic resistance) heal and shield power .

augments.name: Quantum Computing
augments.wikiDescription: Automatically cast an improved version of Camille's Tactical Sweep when an enemy champion is within 650 units of you, winding up over 0. 75 seconds to slash in a 650 radius around you. The slash deals 200 – 350 (based on level) (+ 75% bonus AD) (+ 45% AP) physical damage to enemies within the area (30 second cooldown). Enemies hit by the outer edge of the circle take bonus physical damage equal to 10% (+ 2. 5 % per 100 bonus AD) (+ 1. 6 % per 100 AP) (+ 0. 1 % per 100 bonus health) of their maximum health and are slowed by 80% decaying over 2 seconds. Additionally, you are healed for 80% of the bonus post-mitigation damage against enemy champions hit by the outer edge.

augments.name: Quest: Urf's Champion
augments.name_ja: クエスト: アーフのチャンピオン
augments.wikiDescription: Quest: Score 18 champion takedowns . Reward: Upon completing your Quest , you receive The Golden Spatula . If your inventory is full at the time of quest completion, the item will be granted as soon as a slot in the inventory is available.

augments.name: Quest: Wooglet's Witchcap
augments.name_zh_CN: 任务：沃格勒特的巫师帽
augments.name_ja: クエスト: ウーグレット ウィッチキャップ
augments.wikiDescription: Gain a Needlessly Large Rod . Quest: Obtain Rabadon's Deathcap and Zhonya's Hourglass . Reward: Upon completing your Quest , convert the items you obtained for the quest into Wooglet's Witchcap .

augments.name: Red Envelopes
augments.wikiDescription: Red envelopes will now randomly appear around you every 25 – 15 (based on level) seconds. You can pick up these envelopes by moving over them, granting you between 8 – 15 (based on level) and 22 – 46 (based on level) gold , and 100 bonus movement speed for 3 seconds. Additionally, whenever you pick an envelope, you gain one of the following stats by random: 5 bonus attack damage 5 ability power 5 ability haste 5 bonus armor 5 bonus magic resistance 50 bonus health 10% bonus attack speed 5 bonus movement speed 5 Lethality 5 magic penetration

augments.name: Scopiest Weapons
augments.wikiDescription: Gain ( 250 / 150 ) bonus attack range.

augments.name: Slow Cooker
augments.wikiDescription: Surrounds you in flames, causing you to apply a Burn every second to enemy champions within 500 units for 3 seconds that deals magic damage equal to 「 0. 6 6 % of your maximum health per second. 」 「 2% of your maximum health over the duration. 」 This Burn stacks infinitely and refreshes with each application.

augments.name: Stats on Stats on Stats!
augments.name_ja: ステータス上のステータス上のステータス！
augments.wikiDescription: Gain 4 Stat Anvils , with a higher chance of obtaining Gold and Prismatic tier anvils. Additionally, on the next round of augment selection, you gain an additional reroll per augment slot.

augments.name: Stuck In Here With Me
augments.name_ja: 一緒に閉じ込められた
augments.wikiDescription: Casting your ultimate ability grants you an aura for 2 seconds, growing in size over the duration to up to 500 units. After the duration, you taunt all enemies within the aura for 2 seconds and gain 50% damage reduction for the same duration (30 second cooldown). Additionally, gain 30 ultimate haste. Aura is activated once the ultimate's effect starts or has elapsed . On Katarina , this augment will activate at the start of Death Lotus' channel.

augments.name: Symphony of War
augments.wikiDescription: Gain the Conqueror and Lethal Tempo keystone runes. Conqueror Adaptive force per stack changed to 1. 8 – 3. 3 (based on level) bonus Attack Damage or 3 – 5. 5 (based on level) Ability Power ( Adaptive ). Healing changed to ( 10% / 8% ) of damage dealt. Lethal Tempo Bonus attack speed per stack changed to ( 13% – 18% / 8% – 12% ) (based on level). Maximum bonus attack speed changed to ( 78% – 108% / 48% – 72% ) (based on level). Removed: No longer empowers basic attacks at maximum stacks to fire a bolt that deals bonus adaptive damage. New Effect: At maximum stacks, gain 50 bonus attack range and increase the attack speed cap to 10.

augments.name: Tap Dancer
augments.wikiDescription: Basic attacks on-hit against enemy champions and minions grant 10 bonus movement speed , lasting for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent triggers, and stacking infinitely. Additionally, gain bonus attack speed equal to 10% total movement speed .

augments.name: Transmute: Chaos
augments.wikiDescription: Gain two completely random augments, excluding the other two offerings in your current assortment.

augments.name: Triggered Inferno
augments.name_ja: 巻き起こるインフェルノ
augments.wikiDescription: Your damaging basic attacks and abilities against at least one enemy champion unique from the previous damaging hit made against champions generate a stack of Style for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent unique or non-unique hits and stacking up to 6 times. For each stack, gain 4. 25 % / 4. 5 % / 4. 75 % / 5% (based on level) bonus movement speed , up to a maximum of 25. 5 % / 27% / 28. 5 % / 30% (based on level) . Upon reaching maximum Style stacks, you unleash a torrent of shots for 2. 277 seconds , during which you rapidly shoot at nearby enemies over 2. 013 seconds at sporadic times in 0. 2 -second intervals each (up to 10 times per enemy), dealing 20 – 40 (based on level) (+ 40% AD) (+ 25% AP) physical damage with each shot, reduced by 75% against minions . Enemies below 30% of their maximum health are critically struck for 「 double damage 」 「 40 – 80 (based on level) (+ 80% AD) (+ 50% AP) physical damage 」 (15 second cooldown). This effect ends prematurely if you become affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control . Shot damage applies life steal . Style stacks are consumed at the end of the shooting effect.

augments.name: TrueshotProdigy
augments.name_ja: トゥルーショットプロディジー

augments.name: Ultimate Awakening
augments.wikiDescription: Casting your ultimate ability resets the cooldowns of all your basic abilities and grants you 300 basic ability haste for 15 seconds (20 second cooldown). Additionally, gain 30 ultimate haste.

augments.name: Ultimate Revolution
augments.wikiDescription: Casting your ultimate ability resets its cooldown once its effect starts or has elapsed (75 second cooldown, reset upon death).

augments.name: Upgrade Mikael's Blessing
augments.name_ja: ミカエルの祝福 アップグレード
augments.wikiDescription: Upgrades Mikael's Blessing , reducing the cooldown of Purify to 45 seconds and empowering its active to instead affect you and all nearby allied champions, cleansing all targets of crowd control (excluding Airborne ), healing them for 150 – 450 (based on level) (+ 50% AP) , and granting them 65% tenacity for 3 seconds. Additionally, you are granted Mikael's Blessing for free. If you already have Mikael's Blessing , gain 2300 instead. If your inventory is full, the item will be granted as soon as a slot in the inventory is available.

augments.name: Void Immolation
augments.name_ja: クエスト: イカシアの滅亡

augments.name: Void Rift
augments.wikiDescription: Damaging an enemy champion with an ability summons a Void Scar at the location they were damaged for 6 seconds (0. 75 -second cooldown per target). If another Void Scar is summoned within 1250 units, through the same condition, both Void Scars are consumed to create a rift to the void between them that converges over 0. 6 seconds and has a width of 250 units. Enemies within the rift are dealt 100 – 450 (based on level) (+ 5. 5 per 1 Lethality) (+ 5. 5 per 1 flat magic penetration) magic damage and slowed by 99% decaying over 1 second.

augments.name: Windspeaker's Blessing
augments.wikiDescription: Your or allies' heals and shields on yourself, or your heals and shields on allies, grant the target 30 – 60 (based on level) bonus armor and bonus magic resistance for 3 seconds.

augments.name: All For You
augments.wikiDescription: Your heals and shields on allied champions are increased in effectiveness by 30%.

augments.name: Apex Inventor
augments.wikiDescription: Grants 100 item haste , which is equivalent to 50% cooldown reduction for items. Item Cooldowns Items Base Cooldown Reduced Cooldown with Apex Inventor 1

augments.name: Big Brain
augments.wikiDescription: Gain a shield that absorbs damage equal to 300% AP and lasts until destroyed. Shield is replenished upon respawn and every 70 seconds.

augments.name: Bread And Butter
augments.wikiDescription: Your champion's first basic ability (Q) gains 100 ability haste .

augments.name: Bread and Cheese
augments.wikiDescription: Your champion's third basic ability (E) gains 100 ability haste .

augments.name: Bread And Jam
augments.wikiDescription: Your champion's second basic ability (W) gains 100 ability haste .

augments.name: Celestial Body
augments.wikiDescription: Gain 1500 bonus health , but reduce your damage output by 10%.

augments.name: Cheating
augments.wikiDescription: Your Recall is now functional and is upgraded to Empowered Recall . Completing an Empowered Recall channel enables the shop . Additionally, the spawn platform will now provide healing and resource restoration for you.

augments.name: Critical Healing
augments.wikiDescription: Your heals and shields now have a chance equal to your critical strike chance to increase in effectiveness by 40% (5 second cooldown per cast instance ). Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance .

augments.name: Critical Missile
augments.name_ja: クリティカルミサイル
augments.wikiDescription: Critical strikes against enemy champions launch 1 (+ 1 per 33. 33 % critical strike chance) Firecrackers at the target that each deal 20 – 100 (based on level) magic damage . Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance . Critical strikes from Jeweled Gauntlet and Vulnerability will launch Firecrackers .

augments.name: Critical Rhythm
augments.wikiDescription: Your critical strikes grant you 6% bonus attack speed for 6 seconds, stacking up to 10 times for a total of 60% . Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance .

augments.name: Dawnbringer's Resolve
augments.name_ja: ドーンブリンガーの誓い
augments.wikiDescription: Upon dropping below 50% maximum health , you are healed for 30% maximum health over 3 seconds (45 second cooldown, reset upon death).

augments.name: Demon's Dance
augments.wikiDescription: Gain the Fleet Footwork and Grasp of the Undying keystone runes. Fleet Footwork Removed: No longer has an effectiveness modifier for ranged or minions. Base heal changed to 10 – 100 (based on level) . Heal bonus AD ratio changed to 30% bonus AD . Heal AP ratio changed to 20% AP . Movement speed changed to 20%. Grasp of the Undying Triggered attack bonus health changed to ( 7 / 4 ) . New Effect: Triggered attack now has a base heal of ( 3 / 1. 2 ) . Triggered attack heal health ratio changed to ( 1. 2 % / 0. 48 % ) maximum health .

augments.name: Divine Intervention
augments.wikiDescription: Automatically cast Taric's Cosmic Radiance , calling down a protective star upon you that descends over 2. 5 seconds. Afterwards, you and all allied champions within 400 units become invulnerable for 2. 5 seconds (35 second cooldown).

augments.name: Donation
augments.wikiDescription: Gain 1750 upon acquiring this augment.

augments.name: Double Tap
augments.wikiDescription: Basic attacks that critically strike apply on-hit effects an additional time. Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance .

augments.name: Ethereal Weapon
augments.wikiDescription: Your abilities apply on-hit effects (1 second cooldown per target).

augments.name: Executioner
augments.wikiDescription: Deal 10% increased damage to enemies below 30% of their maximum health . Scoring a champion takedown resets the cooldown of all your basic abilities.

augments.name: Final City Transit
augments.name_ja: ファイナルシティ交通
augments.wikiDescription: Upon death, you summon a train over 1 second that launches towards your killer at full speed, travelling in their direction at a global distance and dealing 150 – 750 (based on level) (+ 65% bonus AD) (+ 50% AP) (+ 15% maximum health) physical damage to enemies it passes through. The train is summoned a slight distance away from the front of your killer, based on their facing direction at the time of your death, and launches towards the position they were located at the time of your death.

augments.name: Firebrand
augments.wikiDescription: Basic attacks apply a Burn for 5 seconds that deals bonus magic damage equal to 「 0. 4 % of the target's maximum health per second. 」 「 2% of the target's maximum health over the duration. 」 This Burn stacks infinitely and refreshes with each application.

augments.name: From Beginning To End
augments.wikiDescription: Gain the Dark Harvest and First Strike keystone runes. Dark Harvest Base damage changed to 50 – 100 (based on level) . Damage per soul changed to 20. Bonus AD ratio changed to 35% bonus AD . AP ratio changed to 25% AP . Gain 8 bonus souls for selecting this augment as not your first augment. First Strike Base gold increased to 20 from 15 (ARAM override value). Bonus damage increased to 10% from 7%.

augments.name: Grandma's Chili Oil
augments.name_ja: おばあちゃんのラー油
augments.wikiDescription: Your next basic attack or ability hit, or Burn effect, against an enemy champion inflicts them with a Burn that deals 「 100 – 350 (based on level) magic damage over 3 seconds, 」 「 16. 67 – 37. 5 (based on level) magic damage every 0. 25 seconds over 3 seconds, 」 as well as releases a canister of chili from the target that lands to a location near them after 0. 75 seconds (3 second cooldown). Upon landing, the canister shatters to create a pool of Chili Oil at the impact area with a radius of 175 units, lasting for 5 seconds. The pool heals you and allied champions within for 30 – 75 (based on level) upon entering and each second of the pool's lifetime thereafter. While enemies are within the pool, they are dealt 150 magic damage every second. For each unique Burn effect source that you have, up to 10, increase the pool's size by 40 units and its damage per tick by 50 magic damage . The healing per tick is also increased by 25 for each unique Burn effect source that the unit being healed has, up to 10. Healing granted by pools counts as self-healing . This effect can be triggered from only one target at a time. Damage over time effects from sources other than items and augments, such as champion abilities or summoner spells, do not count as Burn sources for Grandma's Chili Oil . Eligible Items for Burn : Blackfire Torch , Hollow Radiance , Liandry's Torment , Malignance , Sunfire Aegis , The Golden Spatula , Void Immolation Void Immolation uniquely counts as 2 Burn sources. Eligible Augments for Burn : Buff Buddies, Feel the Burn, Firebrand, Holy Fire, Infernal Conduit, Slow Cooker, Tormentor Grandma's Chili Oil does not count itself as a Burn effect. The pools of Chili Oil will follow their user in and out of Mordekaiser's Realm of Death but will only be visible in the realm they were generated. (bug)

augments.name: Growth Spurt
augments.wikiDescription: Replace a summoner spell with Growth Spurt . Growth Spurt: Enlarge yourself, causing you to knock up enemies within 400 units for 1 second. For the next 7 seconds, you gain 300 (+ 20% maximum health) bonus health and 50% increased size.

augments.name: Holy Fire
augments.wikiDescription: Your heals and shields cause you to fire a missile to the nearest enemy unit within 650 units over 0. 32 seconds, applying a Burn upon arrival that deals magic damage equal to 0. 2 % of the target's maximum health every second over 5 seconds, for a total of 1% (1. 5 -second cooldown). The Burn's per-tick damage increases to up to 0. 8 % of the target's maximum health based on the relative value of the triggering heal or shield against the maximum health of the ally recipient, for a total maximum damage of 4% of the target's maximum health .

augments.name: Impassable
augments.wikiDescription: Gain the Aftershock and Glacial Augment keystone runes. Aftershock Cooldown reduced to 15 seconds from 20. Glacial Augment Cooldown reduced to 15 seconds from 25.

augments.name: It's Critical
augments.wikiDescription: Grants 50% critical strike chance .

augments.name: It's Killing Time
augments.wikiDescription: Upon casting your ultimate ability, you apply Zed's Death Mark to all enemy champions (8 second cooldown). The mark stores 40% of all post-mitigation damage you deal to the affected target, detonating after 5 seconds to deal true damage equal to the damage stored against them.

augments.name: Keystone Conjurer
augments.name_ja: キーストーンの奇術師
augments.wikiDescription: Gain the Arcane Comet and Summon Aery keystone runes. Summon Aery Base damage changed to 30 – 100 (based on level) .

augments.name: Lightning Strikes
augments.name_ja: ライトニングストライク
augments.wikiDescription: Increase your bonus attack speed gained from all sources by 20% . While at 1. 75 attack speed or higher, your basic attacks deal 40 bonus magic damage on-hit.

augments.name: Magic Missile
augments.wikiDescription: Dealing damage to an enemy champion with an ability fires 3 Firecrackers at them that each deal true damage equal to 0. 3 3 % of the target's maximum health , increased to up to 1% based on distance travelled (maximum damage reached at 1000 units). This effect can only trigger once every 6 seconds from the same cast.

augments.name: Marksmage
augments.wikiDescription: Basic attacks deal bonus physical damage equal to 75% AP .

augments.name: Minionmancer
augments.wikiDescription: Your pets deal 40% increased damage as well as gain 40% bonus health and size.

augments.name: Nightstalking
augments.wikiDescription: Scoring a takedown against an enemy champion within 3 seconds of damaging them renders you invisible for 1. 5 seconds. Attacking or casting abilites ends the stealth immediately.

augments.name: Ok Boomerang
augments.wikiDescription: Automatically cast an improved version of Sivir's Boomerang Blade at the closest nearby enemy champion within 1250 units, dealing 40 – 200 (based on level) (+ 30% bonus AD) (+ 20% AP) adaptive damage to enemies hit (10 second cooldown).

augments.name: Outlaw's Grit
augments.wikiDescription: Dashing or blinking grants 12 bonus armor and bonus magic resistance for 15 seconds, stacking up to 5 times for a total of 60 bonus resistances, and refreshing on subsequent triggers.

augments.name: Overflow
augments.wikiDescription: Your abilities' mana costs are doubled, but you also gain 10% (+ 0. 5 % per 100 maximum mana) increased damage as well as self and outgoing healing and shielding .

augments.name: Perseverance
augments.wikiDescription: Grants 1000% base health regeneration , increased to 2000% while below 25% maximum health . This augment prevents the user from being offered the Vampirism augment.

augments.name: Phenomenal Evil
augments.wikiDescription: Gain Veigar's Phenomenal Evil Power . Phenomenal Evil Power: Generate a permanent stack of Phenomenal Evil each time you damage an enemy champion with ability damage . This effect cannot trigger more than once every second globally and once every 3 seconds from the same cast instance . For each stack, gain 1 ability power . If this is not your first augment, start with 40 Phenomenal Evil stacks, granting you 40 ability power . The 40 bonus stacks for selecting this augment as not your first augment are given once the first stack is earned.

augments.name: Pinball
augments.wikiDescription: Your Mark is empowered to instead throw a pinball, which deals 100 – 500 (based on level) bonus true damage and ricochets off of terrain that it collides with. Each time the pinball ricochets, its remaining travel distance is reset, it increases in radius by 25%, deals 20% increased damage, and reduces Mark's remaining cooldown by 30%. The pinball can ricochet up to 4 times, for a maximum radius increase of 100% and a damage increase of 80%. Additionally, your Mark's cooldown is reduced equivalent to 50 ability haste. If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark .

augments.name: Poro Blaster
augments.wikiDescription: You summon a Poro alongside yourself every 3. 5 seconds, up to 5 at a time. Damaging an enemy champion with a basic attack or ability, excluding those which apply damage over time , commands all of your Poros to launch themselves at the target, each dealing true damage equal to 3% of the target's maximum health . If triggered while at the maximum number of summoned Poros , the first Poro to hit the target also knocks them up for 0. 5 seconds. This augment is only offered to up to 1 player on each team for a given game.

augments.name: Quest: Steel Your Heart
augments.name_ja: クエスト: 覚悟を決めろ
augments.wikiDescription: Quest: Obtain Heartsteel and accumulate over 300 bonus health from Colossal Consumption . Reward: Upon completing your Quest , increase the bonus health gained from Heartsteel's Colossal Consumption by 200%.

augments.name: Rabble Rousing
augments.wikiDescription: Casting an ability heals you for 5 – 60 (based on level) (+ 1% maximum health) . Toggled abilities will not trigger this augment as they do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects.

augments.name: Recursion
augments.wikiDescription: Grants 60 ability haste .

augments.name: Restless Restoration
augments.wikiDescription: Heal for 0. 2 – 1. 2 (based on level) (+ 0. 01 % maximum health) per 10 units travelled.

augments.name: Scopier Weapons
augments.wikiDescription: Gain ( 200 / 100 ) bonus attack range.

augments.name: Searing Dawn
augments.wikiDescription: Gain Leona's Sunlight . Sunlight: Your damaging abilities mark enemies, causing them to take 40 – 200 (based on level) bonus magic damage from your ally's next basic attack or ability hit against them (0. 75 -second cooldown per target).

augments.name: Shrink Engine
augments.wikiDescription: Scoring a champion takedown generates a stack, stacking infinitely. For each stack, gain 8 ability haste and 1% bonus movement speed , and reduce your size by 4%. Lose 65% of stacks on death. Size reduction is capped at 80% (20 stacks).

augments.name: Shrink Ray
augments.wikiDescription: Basic attacks on-hit reduce the target's damage dealt by 15% for 3 seconds, refreshing with each hit. Their size is also reduced significantly for the duration.

augments.name: Skilled Sniper
augments.wikiDescription: Hitting an enemy champion with a basic ability while located at least 700 units away from them at the time of the hit reduces its current cooldown by 80% of its total cooldown, modified to 65% for damage over time abilities.

augments.name: Slow And Steady
augments.wikiDescription: Your base attack speed is set to a static amount of 0. 625 and your attack rate no longer benefits from any source of attack speed bonuses. In return, you gain 25 bonus attack damage and convert every 1% bonus attack speed into 1 bonus attack damage .

augments.name: Snowball Roulette
augments.wikiDescription: Hitting an enemy with Mark casts a random harmful summoner spell on them, and also casts a random beneficial summoner spell on yourself. Using Dash casts the beneficial summoner spell on yourself again upon arrival. Additionally, your Mark's cooldown is reduced equivalent to 100 ability haste. If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark . Harmful summoner spells: Exhaust and Ignite Beneficial Summoner spells: Barrier , Clarity , Cleanse , Ghost , and Heal Recasting Barrier and Cleanse refreshes the duration. Recasted Heal will heal less since the Recently Healed debuff will be applied on the first. Ghost can be stacked up to a maximum of 5 times (which is possible with Biggest Snowball Ever augment)

augments.name: Snowball Upgrade
augments.wikiDescription: Your Mark is empowered to hail a snowstorm at the location where the target was hit for 2 seconds, granting sight of the area and dealing 「 200 (+ 200% bonus AD) (+ 120% AP) magic damage 」 「 25 (+ 25% bonus AD) (+ 15% AP) magic damage every 0. 25 seconds 」 to enemies within over the duration, as well as slowing them by 50% (+ 6% per 100 AP) . Additionally, your Mark's cooldown is reduced equivalent to 50 ability haste. If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark .

augments.name: Sonata
augments.wikiDescription: Alternate between automatically casting a modified version of Sona's Aria of Perseverance and modified Song of Celerity , with the former being cast first (10 second cooldown). Aria of Perseverance: Heal yourself for 60 (+ 60% AP) and send out a tone to the most wounded allied champion within 1000 units that heals them for the same amount. Additionally, generate an aura that grants you and tagged allied champions a 80 (+ 40% AP) shield for 1. 5 seconds. Song of Celerity: Gain 30% bonus movement speed for 7 seconds. If you take damage during this time, the duration ends prematurely once or if 3 seconds have elapsed. Additionally, generate an aura that grants tagged allied champions 20% bonus movement speed for 3 seconds.
augments.wikiSet: Fully Automated Wee Woo Wee Woo

augments.name: Soul Eater
augments.wikiDescription: Immobilizing or grounding an enemy champion grants you 20 bonus health , stacking infinitely (5 second cooldown per cast instance ).

augments.name: Soul Siphon
augments.wikiDescription: Heal for 12% of the post-mitigation damage dealt by your critical strikes . Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance . Any damage from Critical strikes will heal, including those from non-basic attack sources ( Talon's Noxian Diplomacy , Ashe's Volley , etc).

augments.name: Spiritual Purification
augments.wikiDescription: Scoring a champion takedown causes the area around the slain champion to explode in a 500 unit radius, dealing adaptive damage to enemies within equal to 15% of their current health and leaving behind a zone for 1. 5 seconds that slows enemies within by 60%.

augments.name: Stats on Stats!

augments.wikiDescription: Gain 3 Stat Anvils , with a higher chance of obtaining Gold and Prismatic tier anvils.

augments.name: Tank Engine
augments.wikiDescription: Scoring a champion takedown generates a stack, stacking infinitely. For each stack, increase your maximum health and size by 5%. Lose 65% of stacks on death.

augments.name: Thread the Needle
augments.wikiDescription: Grants 18% armor penetration and magic penetration .

augments.name: Transmute: Prismatic
augments.wikiDescription: Gain one random Prismatic augment, excluding the other two offerings in your current assortment.

augments.name: Twice Thrice
augments.wikiDescription: Basic attacks generate a stack, up to 2 times. At 2 stacks, your next basic attack consumes all stacks to apply on-hit effects again at 150% effectiveness.

augments.name: Upgrade Hubris
augments.name_ja: ヒュブリス アップグレード
augments.wikiDescription: Upgrades Hubris , empowering Eminence to heal you for 2. 5 % (+ 0. 5 % per stack) maximum health upon being triggered and grant you 10 (+ 5 per stack) bonus movement speed for its duration. Additionally, gain 250 .

augments.name: Upgrade Infinity Edge
augments.name_ja: インフィニティ エッジ アップグレード

Excoriate: Gain a random amount of bonus critical strike damage that scales up to 50% of your critical strike chance , with the value of this amount changing every 0. 25 seconds.

augments.name: Upgrade Sheen

augments.wikiDescription: Upgrades all Spellblade items, empowering the passive effect to deal additional bonus physical damage equal to 4% of the target's maximum health and heal you for 3. 5 % of your maximum health . Additionally, gain 250 .

augments.name: Vampirism
augments.wikiDescription: You can no longer be healed by allies and your health regeneration is set to 0 . Gain 25% omnivamp . Diadem of Songs' Consonance and Moonstone Renewer's Starlit Grace will specifically not target champions with this augment. This augment prevents the user from being offered the Perseverance augment. This augment is not offered if the champion has built Warmog's Armor .

augments.name: Vulnerability
augments.wikiDescription: Damage dealt by items and damage over time effects can now critically strike for (145% + bonus critical damage ) damage (5 second cooldown per cast instance ). Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance . If both Jeweled Gauntlet and Vulnerability are equipped, only rolls the critical strike chance of the augment that has the higher critical damage (or either if equal). The interaction between Jeweled Gauntlet and Vulnerability may behave incorrectly with persistent area damage effects. (bug)

augments.name: With Haste
augments.wikiDescription: Grants bonus movement speed equal to 70% ability haste .

augments.name: Adamant
augments.wikiDescription: Immobilizing or grounding an enemy champion grants 10 bonus armor and bonus magic resistance for 10 seconds, stacking up to 10 times for a total of 100 bonus resistances, and refreshing on subsequent triggers (5 second cooldown per cast instance ).

augments.name: ADAPt
augments.wikiDescription: Convert all of your bonus attack damage into ability power at a rate of 1 ability power per 0. 6 bonus attack damage . Additionally, increase your ability power by 15% .

augments.name: Blunt Force
augments.wikiDescription: Increases attack damage by 20% .

augments.name: Buff Buddies
augments.wikiDescription: Grants the Crest of Cinders and Crest of Insight buffs permanently. Crest of Cinders: Empowers your basic attacks to slow the target by ( 10% / 15% / 25% / 5% / 7. 5 % / 12. 5 % ) (based on level) for 3 seconds and inflict them with a burn for 2 seconds, which deals 8 – 76 (based on level) total true damage over 3 instances over the duration. Each instance deals 2. 67 – 25. 33 (based on level) true damage , with the first instance being applied on-hit and the second and third instances dealt each second over the burn's duration. Subsequent attacks against a burning target will only refresh its duration. While out-of-combat with enemy champions and turrets , you regenerate 「 0. 5 % / 1% / 3% / 9% (based on level) maximum health every 5 seconds. 」 「 0. 05 % / 0. 1 % / 0. 3 % / 0. 9 % (based on level) maximum health every 0. 5 seconds. 」 This effect counts as a Burn source. Crest of Insight: Grants 10 ability haste . If your champion uses mana , restores 「 5. 5 % of maximum mana every 5 seconds; 」 「 0. 55 % of maximum mana every 0. 5 seconds; 」 if your champion uses energy , instead restores 「 5. 5 % of maximum energy every 5 seconds. 」 「 0. 55 % of maximum energy every 0. 5 seconds. 」 The buff is not transferred to the killer when slain.

augments.name: Crack Open That Egg
augments.wikiDescription: Your shields detonate upon expiration, creating an explosion that deals magic damage equal to 100% of the shield's strength to nearby enemies.

augments.name: Crit 'n Cast
augments.name_ja: クリティカルキャスト
augments.wikiDescription: Gain ability haste equal to 40% of your critical strike chance .

augments.name: Deft
augments.wikiDescription: Grants 60% bonus attack speed .

augments.name: Dive Bomber
augments.wikiDescription: Upon death, you explode to deal true damage equal to 20% of the target's maximum health to enemies within 500 units.

augments.name: Don't Blink

augments.name: Erosion
augments.wikiDescription: Each instance of damage dealt to an enemy reduces their armor and magic resistance by 1. 5 % for 4 seconds, stacking up to 20 times for a total of 30% resistances reduction.

augments.name: escAPADe
augments.wikiDescription: Convert all of your ability power into bonus attack damage at a rate of 1 bonus attack damage per 1. 66 ability power . Additionally, increase your total attack damage by 15% . Does not convert the Ability Power obtained from Riftmaker 's Void Infusion , nor from Archangel's Staff or Seraph's Embrace 's Awe . (bug)

augments.name: Escape Plan
augments.wikiDescription: Upon dropping below 35% of your maximum health , gain a shield for 65% of your maximum health , 150% bonus movement speed , and reduced size (75 second cooldown). These effects all decay over 5. 5 seconds.

augments.name: FireFox
augments.name_ja: ファイヤーフォックス
augments.wikiDescription: Automatically cast a modified version of Ahri's Fox-Fire , gaining 25% bonus movement speed that decays over 2 seconds and conjuring 3 flames that orbit you clockwise for up to 2. 5 seconds at a radius of 150 units. The flames will fly toward the nearest visible enemies within 550 units, dealing 35 – 160 (based on level) (+ 25% bonus AD (+ 25% AP) adaptive damage , reduced to 「 10. 5 – 48 (based on level) (+ 7. 5 % bonus AD (+ 7. 5 % AP) 」 「 30% of the original damage 」 for enemies hit by subsequent flames from the same cast (7 second cooldown).

augments.name: First-Aid Kit
augments.wikiDescription: Grants 20% heal and shield power .

augments.name: Flash 2
augments.wikiDescription: Replace a summoner spell with Flash . Additionally, gain 70 summoner spell haste.

augments.name: Flashbang
augments.wikiDescription: Using Flash creates an explosion around the blink location that deals 70 – 240 (based on level) (+ 70% AD) (+ 60% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies and slows them by 35% for 1. 25 seconds. Additionally, the cooldown of your Flash resets upon your death. If Flash is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Flash .

augments.name: Frost Wraith
augments.wikiDescription: Automatically cast a modified version of Lissandra's Ring of Frost , creating a cold pulse around you in 450 radius that roots nearby enemies for 1. 25 seconds (6. 5 second cooldown). This modified ability does not deal damage.

augments.name: Goredrink
augments.wikiDescription: Gain 15% omnivamp .

augments.name: Guilty Pleasure
augments.wikiDescription: Immobilizing or grounding an enemy champion heals you for 30 – 250 (based on level) (+ 1. 5 % maximum health) (5 second cooldown per cast instance ).

augments.name: Hat on a Hat
augments.wikiDescription: Gain 15 ability power and 8 bonus magic resistance for each headwear item or hat you have in your inventory, reduced to 8 ability power and 4 bonus magic resistance for hats obtained from Cappa Juice and Stat Bonus . Eligible Epic Items: Haunting Guise , Spectre's Cowl Eligible Legendary Items: Abyssal Mask , Bloodletter's Curse , Cosmic Drive , Diadem of Songs , Edge of Night , Experimental Hexplate , Fimbulwinter , , Hollow Radiance , Hubris , Jak'Sho, The Protean , Knight's Vow , Liandry's Torment , Rabadon's Deathcap , Riftmaker , Shurelya's Battlesong , Whispering Circlet , Wooglet's Witchcap The stats gained for an eligible item is equal to 460 . The stats gained for a stack of Cappa Juice and Stat Bonus is equal to 240 .

augments.name: Heavy Hitter
augments.wikiDescription: Basic attacks deal bonus physical damage equal to 3. 5 % of your maximum health .

augments.name: Hextech Soul
augments.name_ja: ヘクステック ソウル
augments.wikiDescription: Grants the Hextech Dragon Soul , or a different Dragon Soul if you aleady have it.

augments.name: Homeguard
augments.wikiDescription: Gain 100% bonus movement speed . This bonus is lost for 6 seconds after taking damage from champions.

augments.name: Ice Cold
augments.wikiDescription: Your slowing effects reduce the movement speed of targets by an additional 75 .

augments.name: Infernal Soul
augments.name_ja: インファーナルソウル
augments.wikiDescription: Grants the Infernal Dragon Soul , or a different Dragon Soul if you aleady have it.

augments.name: Kill Secured
augments.wikiDescription: Gain 60% bonus movement speed towards enemy champions below 40% of their maximum health .

augments.name: Leg Day
augments.wikiDescription: Gain 50 bonus movement speed and 40% slow resist .

augments.name: Light 'em Up!
augments.wikiDescription: Basic attacks generate a stack, up to 4. The fourth stack consumes them all to quickly launch 4 Firecrackers at the target that each deal 11 – 80 (based on level) (+ 35% bonus AD) (+ 19% AP) bonus magic damage on-hit, for a total of 44 – 320 (based on level) (+ 140% bonus AD) (+ 76% AP) .

augments.name: Mighty Shield
augments.wikiDescription: Gain 40 – 100 (based on level) adaptive force for 3 seconds upon gaining a shield (5 second cooldown).

augments.name: Mind to Matter
augments.wikiDescription: Grants bonus health equal to 50% maximum mana . Maximum bonus health granted by this effect is capped at 99,999 bonus health .

augments.name: Ocean Soul
augments.wikiDescription: Grants the Ocean Dragon Soul , which has a modified base heal value of 100, or a different Dragon Soul if you aleady have it.

augments.name: Poltergeist
augments.wikiDescription: Replace a summoner spell with Poltergeist . Poltergeist: Casts both Barrier and Ghost on yourself, both lasting 5 seconds and with the former granting a shield for 110 – 440 (based on level) and the latter granting 30% bonus movement speed .

augments.name: Purist - Caster
augments.wikiDescription: Convert all of your bonus attack speed into ability haste at a rate of 0. 65 ability haste per 1% bonus attack speed . Additionally, your abilities' total cooldowns are reduced by 10%.

augments.name: Repulsor
augments.wikiDescription: Upon dropping below 35% of your maximum health , you knock back all enemies within a 500 radius by 750 units and slow them by 90% for 1. 5 seconds (25 second cooldown, resets upon death).

augments.name: Scoped Weapons
augments.wikiDescription: Gain ( 75 / 50 ) bonus attack range.

augments.name: Self Destruct
augments.wikiDescription: Automatically attach a bomb to yourself that detonates after 5 seconds, creating an explosion that deals true damage equal to 20% of the target's maximum health to enemies within 350 units and knocks them up for 0. 75 seconds (25 second cooldown). The airborne status effect from the knock back does not interrupt channels nor disable abilities , and is not resisted by immunity nor spell shield . (bug)

augments.name: Shadow Runner
augments.wikiDescription: After dashing , blinking , or exiting stealth , gain 300 bonus movement speed for 2 seconds.

augments.name: Slap Around
augments.wikiDescription: Immobilizing or grounding an enemy champion grants you 6 bonus Attack Damage or 10 Ability Power ( Adaptive ), stacking infinitely (5 second cooldown per cast instance ). Lose 50% of stacks on death. If the bonus attack damage and the ability power of the unit are equal , the stat granted is always bonus AD . (unexpected)

augments.name: Sonic Boom
augments.wikiDescription: Granting a buff , heal , or shield to your ally deals 30 – 150 (based on level) true damage to enemies within 450 units of them and slows targets by 30% for 2 seconds (2 second cooldown).

augments.name: Speed Demon
augments.wikiDescription: Whenever you damage an enemy champion with an ability, gain 200 bonus movement speed decaying over 0. 75 seconds.

augments.name: Spin Me Right Round
augments.wikiDescription: Replace a summoner spell with Akshan's Heroic Swing ( 10 second cooldown , starts post-effect). Heroic Swing - Active: You can activate Heroic Swing three times before the ability goes on cooldown, and you can use the third cast only after 0. 5 seconds of the second cast. An attack or movement command may be inputted to use the second and third casts. First Cast: Fire a hook in the target direction that embeds in the first terrain hit for 2 seconds. Heroic Swing's second cast can be used while the hook is attached. If the hook fails to attach or you become immobilized , grounded , or polymorphed within the duration, Heroic Swing is cancelled and placed on full cooldown. Second Cast: Swing around the terrain in either a clockwise or counterclockwise direction based on the position of the cursor relative to your facing direction , stopping upon colliding with an enemy champion or terrain. While swinging, fire at the nearest visible enemy within 500 units every 0. 231 seconds to deal them 15 – 75 (based on level) (+ 15% AD) × (1 + 0. 3 per 100% bonus attack speed) physical damage and apply on-hit effects for each shot, with on-hit damage reduced to 25% effectiveness. The dash will be interrupted if you are affected by any immobilizing or polymorphing crowd control during the dash. Third Cast: End the swing by jumping to the target location and fire one last shot at a nearby visible enemy. Scoring an enemy champion takedown reduces Heroic Swing's current cooldown to 0. 5 seconds.

Eep! and Swirlseed , Poppy's Keeper's Verdict , etc.

This Burn stacks infinitely and refreshes with each application.

augments.name: Twin Fire

augments.name: Typhoon
augments.wikiDescription: Basic attacks launch a Firecracker at a nearby enemy champion that deals 30% AD physical damage and applies on-hit effects.

augments.name: Ultimate Unstoppable
augments.name_ja: 破竹のアルティメット
augments.wikiDescription: Casting your ultimate ability grants you crowd control immunity for 3 seconds (8 second cooldown).

augments.name: Upgrade Collector
augments.name_ja: コレクター アップグレード
augments.wikiDescription: Upgrades The Collector , empowering Death to have its execution threshold increased by 0. 5 % each time you kill an enemy champion, capped at a threshold of 12.5% of the target's maximum health , and Taxes to generate a further 25 (total 50 ) from kills. Additionally, gain 250 .

augments.name_ja: カトラス アップグレード

augments.name: Upgrade Thornmail
augments.name_ja: ソーンメイル アップグレード
augments.wikiDescription: Upgrades Bramble Vest and Thornmail , empowering Thorns to generate a protective shell around you. The shell is broken by the next enemy champion to use a basic attack on-hit against you, which causes them to take 50 – 250 (based on level) (+ 30% armor) (+ 30% magic resistance) (+ 12% maximum health) magic damage . Shell regenerates after 20 – 5 (based on level) seconds of being out-of-combat with enemy champions.

augments.name: Upgrade Zhonya's
augments.name_ja: ゾーニャ アップグレード
augments.wikiDescription: Upgrades Seeker's Armguard , Wooglet's Witchcap , and Zhonya's Hourglass , empowering Stasis to allow you to move during its active effect, during which time you also gain 50% bonus movement speed . Additionally, the cooldown of Zhonya's Hourglass' Stasis is reduced to 45 seconds.

augments.name: Weighted Popoffs
augments.wikiDescription: Hitting an enemy champion with an ability generates a stack of Popoff for 6 seconds, stacking up to 6 times. For each stack, your basic abilities' cooldowns progress 2. 5 % faster. At maximum Popoff stacks, this value is doubled, for a total of a 30% faster progression time.

augments.name: Wind Beneath Blade
augments.wikiDescription: Gain 1. 5 bonus movement speed per 1 Lethality or flat magic penetration , and 5 bonus movement speed per 10% armor penetration or magic penetration .

augments.name: Witchful Thinking
augments.wikiDescription: Grants 20 – 80 (based on level) ability power .

augments.name: Zealot
augments.wikiDescription: Gain 35% (+ 5% per 100 AP) bonus attack speed and 25% (+ 5% per 100 AP) critical strike chance .
